ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $O$ is a point on the line $AB$, $\angle COD$ is a right angle, $OE$ bisects $\angle BOC$, $\angle AOC=40^\circ$, then what is the degree measure of $\angle DOE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because$ $\angle AOC = 40^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle BOC = 180^\circ - \angle AOC = 140^\circ$,\\
$\because$ OE bisects $\angle BOC$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle COE = \angle BOE = 70^\circ$,\\
$\because$ $\angle COD$ is a right angle, that is $\angle COD = 90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle DOE = \angle COD - \angle COE = \boxed{20^\circ}$.
